entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf Planeswalker bonded to Zendikar and Ashaya, who loses her connection to the land and is rescued at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Nissa's giant tree-like elemental, a manifestation of Zendikar, who collapses when the connection is torn away.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker who rescues the last survivors at Sea Gate and leads them to the new encampment.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: An injured merfolk whom Nissa saves; she is reunited with Gideon.

entities.name: Dest
entities.description: A kor healer who treats Jori and reunites with a kor woman at the camp.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The puzzle-solver Gideon brought back, waiting at the encampment.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The living world whose power Nissa has bonded with, and whose silence follows the torn connection.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monstrous swarms hunting through the Vastwood and overrunning Sea Gate.

entities.name: The Vastwood Forest
entities.description: The forest of heart trees where Nissa and Ashaya fight.

entities.name: Fartree Hamlet
entities.description: A treehouse hamlet of humans besieged by two Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The fallen city where Nissa finds herself surrounded by Eldrazi.

entities.name: The heart trees
entities.description: Ancient trees that mate for life, linked by shared vines.

entities.name: The leylines
entities.description: Glowing green lines of power through Zendikar that Nissa uses.

entities.name: The humans of Fartree Hamlet
entities.description: A tribe of tree-dwelling humans who communicate through chatter sloths.

events.summary: Ashaya relays a distress call from Fartree Hamlet, and Nissa and Ashaya rush to help, finding three Eldrazi instead of two.
events.quote: But the chatter was wrong; there were three Eldrazi, not two.

events.summary: Nissa chooses to attack the twin Eldrazi at the hamlet first, planning to reach the heart trees after.
events.quote: "We have to give the most help we can give,"

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya rescue the humans from the treehouses by bending a tree and shielding them with a wall of land.
events.quote: Nissa pulled on the tree, urging it to bend to her.

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the first twin Eldrazi by snapping the tree into its faceplate and gutting it.
events.quote: Its limbs went limp, and then the monstrous thing teetered back and crashed to the forest floor.

events.summary: Nissa rips the second twin apart with root tentacles and saves the humans from its falling body.
events.quote: carried the people back and away as the Eldrazi struck the ground.

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya arrive too late at the thicket, where the Eldrazi has killed all but two heart trees, and then kill it.
events.quote: The monster was both killed and buried in the same stroke.

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya promise the last heart tree that Zendikar will fight on, and they press on in pursuit of the titan.
Nissa and Ashaya are struck by terrible pain as the connection to Zendikar is torn away, and Ashaya collapses and shatters.
events.quote: Nissa watched as Ashaya's branches snapped and shattered on the ground.

events.summary: Nissa wakes in silence, unable to feel Zendikar or Ashaya, and stumbles toward a sea of Eldrazi at Sea Gate.
events.quote: But there was nothing there to grasp.

events.summary: A wounded merfolk saves Nissa from walking into an Eldrazi.
events.quote: It was a merfolk, one clad in thick, sharp armor made of seashells.

events.summary: Nissa carries Jori En and fights with her sword, but without Zendikar's help she is pinned by an Eldrazi.
events.quote: She pulled on her arm with her all, but the tentacle was too heavy.

events.summary: Kor on a floating rock rescue Nissa and Jori with hooked ropes.
events.quote: The next moment the tentacle was pulled off of her

events.summary: A huge Eldrazi lands on the rock and Gideon appears, lashing it away with his sural and hauling everyone up.
events.quote: four glowing, white whips fly through the air and lash into the Eldrazi's side.

events.summary: Gideon and Jori reunite, and he leads the survivors across floating rocks to a nearby encampment.
Nissa tells Gideon her connection to Zendikar was ripped away, but Gideon says his power is unchanged.
events.quote: "Mine is gone. It was ripped away.

events.summary: Gideon is welcomed at the encampment with the rescued survivors while Nissa reaches out and finds Zendikar silent and empty.

relations.note: Her friend, bonded through the leylines.
relations.quote: her home, her world, her friend.
Nissa could feel the message Ashaya sent to the tree on behalf of Zendikar.

relations.note: Hunts the titan and its spawn.
relations.quote: until they had found the titan, until they had destroyed it, until they had won.

relations.note: Rescues her and the last survivors.
Brought him back to help solve the puzzle.
Nissa saves her from the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: "I've got you." Nissa lifted the merfolk and shouldered her.
"It was him," the kor, Dest, said, indicating Gideon.
